info.title: PoYo AI - Generate Persona API
info.description: Create reusable musical personas from existing audio tracks

post.description: Create a reusable musical persona from an existing audio track

input.name: Smooth Jazz Singer
input.description: A sultry jazz vocalist with smooth, mellow tones. Specializes in late-night jazz ballads with piano accompaniment and warm, intimate delivery.

input.name: Electric Rock Band
input.description: High-energy rock band with powerful guitar riffs, driving drums, and passionate vocals. Perfect for anthemic rock songs and energetic performances.

error.message: Persona already exists for this audio

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

model.description:
API model identifier.

Must be `generate-persona` for this endpoint.

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for result notifications

task_id.description: Unique identifier of a completed Generate Music or Extend Music task.

audio_id.description:
Unique identifier of the audio track to create Persona for.

This ID is returned in the callback data after music generation completes.

name.description:
Descriptive name for the persona.

Should capture the musical style or character of the persona.

description.description:
Detailed description of the Persona's musical characteristics, style, and personality.

Include details about genre, mood, instrumentation, vocal style, and any unique characteristics.
description.example: A sultry jazz vocalist with smooth, mellow tones. Specializes in late-night jazz ballads with piano accompaniment.

vocal_start.description: Start of a 10-30 second segment; requires vocal_end.

vocal_end.description: End of the segment; requires vocal_start, must be greater than vocal_start, and must make the selected range 10-30 seconds.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created
